svg.text: LeadFlow — Sequence Diagram: Setter-Closer Collaboration & Audit Trail Lifecycle
1.1 Enters customer info, selects Closer (Alex) & clicks "Create Appointment"
1.5 new HistoryEntry(setter, action="created", toStatus="PENDING") & new Lead(...)
Increments "Total Submitted" KPI & renders new lead row in table
Displays green floating toast & closes dialog
2.1 Closer logs in as Alex Rivera, clicks "View Details" on assigned lead
Renders Customer Meta, Audit Timeline, and Editable Outcome Form (Alex is assigned)
2.4 Submits Outcome Form: newStatus="WON", note="Signed annual enterprise contract"
Security Gate: Asserts closer.role === 'closer' && lead.closerId === closer.id
2.7 lead.updateStatus("WON", note, closerUser) -> Appends immutable HistoryEntry
2.10 Observer callback: updates "Deals Won" KPI & replaces status pill in table
refreshCurrentDetails(): appends new HistoryEntry to timeline view & Toast.success()
3. CLOSED FEEDBACK LOOP: SETTER INSPECTS IMMUTABLE AUDIT TIMELINE
3.1 Setter switches back to Sarah Jenkins, re-opens "View Details" on Acme Innovations
Renders read-only notice banner + full timeline showing Closer Alex's transition (PENDING -> WON) & timestamped notes
Loop closed: Setter verifies appointment was successfully won
